title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E02 — Speedy Chicken and Mushroom Puff Pastry Pie
Jamie cooks three one-pan recipes that provide a perfect solution for busy life: a superfast, flavour-packed smoky noodle soup; the cleverest homemade bread in a pan; and a chicken & mushroom pie with a time-saving tip for perfect pastry.

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E03 — Easy Stuffed Dumplings and British Fish & Chips
Jamie saves money with easy stuffed leftover dumplings, a budget frozen-fish chip shop cheat, a store-cupboard jar blondie cake, pocket-pleasing pork tacos, and a brilliant air-fryer tinned pineapple tarte tatin dessert!

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E03 — Crispy Rolled Pork Belly and Risotto
Jamie shares more fabulous one-pan dishes: foolproof tray-baked salmon in a bag; super-easy tomato fritters that you can rattle out in a frying pan; and roasted rolled pork and a risotto that are BOTH cooked in the same casserole pan. Result!

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E04 — Not Your Nonna's Gnocchi and Meatballs
In this episode Jamie takes midweek meals up a notch, knocking out a flavour-packed, simple gnocchi supper and giant spicy meatballs full of delicious time-saving cheats, and turns a family favourite on its head with his upside-down fish pie.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E01 — Weeknight Roast Lamb and Eggplant
Jamie kicks off his new one-pan series with a simplified and delicious frying-pan pasta, a clever twist on a fish pie that's full of flavour with none of the fuss, and a sublime roast lamb feast with a fantastic hack to speed up cooking.

title: Jamie Oliver's One-Pan Wonders
description:
S01 E02 — Speedy Chicken and Mushroom Puff Pastry Pie

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E02 — Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice
We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S02 E03 — Every Kind of Rib: Dino, Fried, Smoked, Grilled and Glazed
It's Rib Day on BBQ Smokeout! Noah and Kev are cooking Dino Beef Ribs, Fried St. Louis Pork Ribs, Smoked Pork Spare Ribs with a Hennessey Glaze, and Smoke-Grilled Baby Backs. Plus we're making good old fashioned Dirty Cabbage.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S01 E01 — Beef Shank is the New Brisket
Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor's Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.

title: Barbecue: Smoke Out
description:
S01 E04 — These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair
Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.

title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
description:
S01 E02 — Caprese Chicken Burgers and Pork and Fennel Ragu
From crispy, herby Caprese chicken burgers to golden spinach pies, creamy pork & fennel ragù with fresh pappardelle, and a comforting tinned peach cobbler with fruit-rippled cream, Jamie proves budget-friendly cooking can be utterly delicious.

title: Jamie Oliver's Feasts for Less
description:
S01 E01 — Hearty Chicken Pot Pie and French Toast Crumpets with Bacon
From a cosy chicken hotpot with braised cabbage to cheesy French-toast crumpets with smashed peas and bacon, a quick, aromatic fish curry, and a golden pear & almond cake with orange drizzle, Jamie proves simple ingredients really can shine.

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E05 — Peperonata Eggs on Toast and Baked Cinnamon Apples
Jamie makes a no-cook store-cupboard olive pasta sauce, a cheap frozen-pepper peperonata stew with coddled eggs, a wallet-friendly chicken thigh and bean roast dinner, and budget-clever homemade takeaway kebabs with flatbreads!

description:
S01 E06 — Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta
Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E01 — Not Your Nonna's Risotto
Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits.

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E06 — Smoked Brisket Hero
Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters.

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E05 — Santa Maria Tri-tip Hero
If you love outdoor grilling AND flexing your skills by entertaining guests, the next Backyard BBQ Hero is required viewing. Fire up the grill for a show-stopping Santa Maria-style tri tip, a zesty salad, and an unbelievable dinner bread!

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E03 — Pulled Pork Party Hero
It's always kind of a party in the backyard, but it's really a party when Susie breaks out the smoker for some legendary pulled pork sliders, a homemade coleslaw, and a mac and cheese so creamy even the grownups will rave about it.

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E02 — Steakhouse Hero
Susie's bringing in a special guest so you can bring the steakhouse to your backyard! Christie Vanover of Girls Can Grill joins the fun and brings some fingerling potatoes to round out the ribeyes, asparagus, and a one-of-a-kind compound butter!

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E04 — Mexican Carne Asada Hero
Grill fatigue is a very real problem, but the globally-inspired menu of carne asada, tomatillo salsa, Mexican street corn, and Tex-Mex beans in this episode of Backyard BBQ Hero is sure to reignite the fire inside and get you outside cooking!

title: Backyard BBQ Hero
description:
S01 E01 — Weeknight Family Dinner Hero
Susie from Hey Grill Hey teaches you how to make a full family dinner right in your own backyard in under 30 minutes! When you serve this grilled honey mustard chicken, creamed corn, and mixed veggies, you'll feel like a Weeknight BBQ Hero!

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E09 — Game Day Chicago-Style Beef Sandwich
Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E08 — Crispy Duck Noodle Soup
Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E03 — Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew
Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E07 — Striped Bass Crudo and Smoky Summer Succotash
Chef Andrew Zimmern celebrates summer's bounty with an elegant bass crudo and a whole roasted striped bass topped with a herb-packed compound butter and served alongside a smoky corn succotash studded with charred poblanos.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto
Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E06 — Grilled Eggplant Caponata Toast and Crispy Squab Katsu
Andrew Zimmern creates an elegant, seared pigeon toast crowned with a Sicilian caponata bursting with grilled eggplant, olives, and capers and a crispy pigeon katsu served with a refreshing shaved cabbage salad and punchy ginger-carrot vinaigrette.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture
Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce
Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E02 — Spring Onion Chicken Curry and Sausage Broccoli Pizza
Jamie elevates asparagus spears for a fishy feat, makes spring onions the star of the show in his spicy green chicken curry and gives purple sprouting broccoli an Italian-inspired makeover.

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E03 — Stuffed Salmon Celebration and Almond Custard Tart
Jamie snazzes up some spuds with wild garlic pesto, creates a broad bean mezze, rustles up a beautiful spring salad and honours rhubarb in a luscious custard tart with almond brittle.

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E04 — Summer-y Sweet Pea Risotto and Slow Roasted Pork
Jamie celebrates summer with roasted fennel pork & gratin, oozy pea risotto, and rainbow slaw chicken wraps. He shares edible hanging basket tips. The feast finishes with stunning mackerel on sun-dried tomato couscous with colorful beets.

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E05 — Buddy's Strawberry Rice Pudding and Summer Tomato Chicken Bake
Jamie cooks a chicken sheet pan dinner with early tomatoes, potatoes and chorizo. Buddy helps pick strawberries for quick jam rice pudding. The summer feast ends with spicy shrimp skewers with homegrown chillies and a refreshing cucumber gazpacho.

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E06 — Endless Summer: From Grilled Panzanella Salad to Sour Cherry Tart
Jamie ends summer with crispy duck in a rich plum sauce & roast potatoes. Grilled peppers star in panzanella. Garden zucchini become Mediterranean rice. Sweet finale: sour cherry frangipane with crème fraîche.

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E02 — Creamy Chicken Pot Pie and Chocolate Tiramisu
Jamie cooks a midweek traybake of roast veg and Camembert. He turns poached chicken into a creamy chicken & chive pie, serves up his easy green chilli salsa under sizzling butterflied prawns, and finishes it all off with decadent chocolate tiramisù.

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E04 — Jarred Pepper Pasta and Sheet Pan Brisket
Jamie cooks a speedy jarred-pepper pasta, crispy chicken in baked-bread sauce, and a beef brisket tray bake - all prepped in minutes. He makes shelf-raid spiced haricot beans, and rounds it all off with a fast and simple strawberry & balsamic tart.

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E01 — Gochujang Chicken Sheet Pan Dinner
Jamie cooks a speedy midweek chicken tray bake. He shows us cool ways to upgrade salmon, knocks up a shelf-raid quesadilla toastie, and transforms a batch-cook Bolognese into cheesy bread bowls. All finished off with a super simple banoffee tart.

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E05 — Smash Burger and Creamy Chicken with Mushrooms
Jamie cooks a midweek meal of speedy sweet pea chicken, a juicy Smash burger and a chicken and mushroom rice traybake. He batch-cooks his seven-veg sauce, followed by a spicy fish soup. And finishes off with a perfect pudding of tinned fruit granita.

title: Jamie Oliver: Fast & Simple
description:
S01 E03 — Easy Pantry Staple Fish Cakes
Jamie shares a simple salmon dish perfect for a midweek meal, and some no-fuss fish cakes made from tins. He cooks a lamb Madras traybake, as well as a no-cook pasta sauce, and crowns it all off with a hot and crispy ice cream parcel!

title: Grill'n After Dark
description:
S01 E05 — Go Burger or Go Home!
Tonight is a trio of backyard burgers! We're making Oklahoma Smashed Onion Burgers, New York Steakhouse Burgers and Fries, and Bougie Castle-Inspired Sliders.

title: Grill'n After Dark
description:
S01 E03 — Midnight Sandwich Express
It's sandwich night! We're making our favorite handheld late-night delights: Chicken Parm Hero, (Not a Philly) Cheesesteak, and Bodega Chopped Cheese. We're going to light the grills, pour some drinks, and show you how to make 'em in your backyard.

title: Grill'n After Dark
description:
S01 E06 — Breakfast After Dark
We're making our late-night breakfast for dinner standards with the Waffle House All-Star, Steak and Eggs, and a Fast Food Sausage Breakfast Sandwich.

title: Grill'n After Dark
description:
S01 E04 — Better Than Delivery Pizza Night
We're grilling our three favorite styles of pizza tonight: Chicago Tavern with Sausage and Hot Giardiniera, New York Ricotta and Hot Honey, and a spicy Detroit Pepperoni.

title: Grill'n After Dark
description:
S01 E02 — Late Night Mexican Food Truck
The Grill Dads bring late-night Mexican food truck eats to your backyard with pollo al pastor tacos, Mission-style carne asada burritos, and mini beef chimichangas.

title: Grill'n After Dark
description:
S01 E01 — Winner, Winner, Chicken Dinner
Tonight is all about chicken comfort-food dishes: a Gochujang Hot Honey Chicken Sandwich, Almost Buffalo Wings, and a Spicy Chicken Salad Wrap. We're going to light the grills, pour some drinks, and show you how to make 'em in your backyard.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S01 E07 — South Carolina Peach-Glazed Ribs with Rice Middlins
When Pat's friends and fellow barbecue chefs, Bryan Furman and Dr. Howard Conyers, come to town, the guys dig deep into the tricks and traditions of one of Bryan's specialties: pork ribs.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire
description:
S02 E08 — The Roscoe Family Legacy: Alabama Pit Ribs
Pat heads to Birmingham to team up with artist and chef Roscoe Hall, cooking ribs inspired by Roscoe's family legacy.

title: Barbecue: Life of Fire

description:

description:

Tonight is a trio of backyard burgers! We're making Oklahoma Smashed Onion Burgers, New York Steakhouse Burgers and Fries, and Bougie Castle-Inspired Sliders.

title: Grill'n After Dark
description:
S01 E03 — Midnight Sandwich Express
It's sandwich night! We're making our favorite handheld late-night delights: Chicken Parm Hero, (Not a Philly) Cheesesteak, and Bodega Chopped Cheese. We're going to light the grills, pour some drinks, and show you how to make 'em in your backyard.

title: Grill'n After Dark
description:
S01 E06 — Breakfast After Dark
We're making our late-night breakfast for dinner standards with the Waffle House All-Star, Steak and Eggs, and a Fast Food Sausage Breakfast Sandwich.

S01 E04 — Better Than Delivery Pizza Night
We're grilling our three favorite styles of pizza tonight: Chicago Tavern with Sausage and Hot Giardiniera, New York Ricotta and Hot Honey, and a spicy Detroit Pepperoni.

title: Grill'n After Dark
description:
S01 E02 — Late Night Mexican Food Truck
The Grill Dads bring late-night Mexican food truck eats to your backyard with pollo al pastor tacos, Mission-style carne asada burritos, and mini beef chimichangas.

description:
S01 E01 — Winner, Winner, Chicken Dinner
Tonight is all about chicken comfort-food dishes: a Gochujang Hot Honey Chicken Sandwich, Almost Buffalo Wings, and a Spicy Chicken Salad Wrap. We're going to light the grills, pour some drinks, and show you how to make 'em in your backyard.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E04 — Between Two Buns
Is it a burger? Is it a sandwich? Could a burger actually be a sandwich? Not even Frankie knows the answer, but one thing is certain: whatever you want to call them, these fun twists and familiar flavor combos are super satisfying to scarf down.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E05 — Struggle Splurge
The key to treating yourself on a budget is to keep it simple: these elegant dinners taste like restaurant specials, but they can be prepared in under one hour - perfect for easy weeknight meals for a family of any size on a busy schedule.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E06 — But First, Brunch
Bring your loved ones together over a delicious brunch spread made with love. Whether you're celebrating a major milestone or simply toasting to the weekend, Frankie's money-saving menu will have guests buzzing for more.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E07 — Saved By The Bowl
When you're craving a quick nutritious meal, say no more to throwing cash down the gutter for overpriced takeout bowls! Frankie recreates three restaurant favorites for a fraction of the cost, sparing your bank account without sacrificing flavor.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E08 — Summer Cookout
Soak up summer with the ultimate outdoor cookout, featuring smashburgers, pasta salad and scrumptious sweets. These classic dishes can be prepared indoors or out, making them the perfect recipes for backyard dinner parties on warm summer nights.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E09 — Picnic Lunches
It's field trip day, and Frankie shows off his best handheld lunches perfect for leisurely days at the park, the beach or the pool. These sturdy meals are made to travel and only get better with time.
